Subject: Unit economics deep-dive: pricing & $/1M tokens

Hi Alicia —

Great to speak earlier. Per our discovery call, I wanted to recap the ask and proposed next steps so we can align on a short unit-econ model before the exec review: 

Summary of FintechX context:
- Primary feature: real-time personalized financial advice in-app (chat + single-turn summarization).
- Expected traffic pattern: 1.5M to 5M tokens/day initially, scaled to 15–20M tokens/day in 12 months (spiky by GMT).
- Latency SLO: 300–400ms p95 for interactive chat.

Specific asks from your side:
1) Verified target cost per $/1M tokens to hit business margin targets (what's your target CP1M?).
2) Budget range for first 12 months and acceptable ramp timeline.
3) Any procurement constraints (PO, security questionnaire timeline).

Next steps (proposed):
- We'll run a quick unit-econ calc: cost per active user / $/feature using your stated volumes, accounting for batching/kv-cache savings and likely mix of generation vs embeddings.
- Share a short spreadsheet (attached) with model assumptions and a recommended pricing profile (quantization + reserved capacity vs hosted).
- 30-min follow-up call with Rishi (SE) to validate latency/throughput assumptions and an ask list for a pilot.

Attachments: unit_econ_model.xlsx (working model), redwood-pricing-cheatsheet.pdf (reference pricing buckets)

Can you confirm the volume buckets (monthly tokens) and a target $/1M tokens (or margin target) so we can lock the numbers?

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Unit economics deep-dive: pricing & $/1M tokens

Thanks Alicia — this is exactly what we needed. Quick reactions and an initial set of unit-econ numbers (high level):

Assumptions we used in the attached spreadsheet:
- Mix: 75% interactive chat (streaming generation), 25% embeddings/aux.
- Token efficiency (batching + KV cache effect): reduces billed tokens per UX by ~15% at your expected scale.
- Candidate model family: 8B quantized variant vs 16B open model for a small latency premium.

Initial costs (hosted API baseline estimates):
- Pilot (45M tokens): infra + model cost ~ $1,600–$2,000 -> ~$35–$45 per $1M tokens (pilot inefficiencies raise unit cost).
- Month 6 (900M tokens): with reserved capacity & batching: ~$18–$28 per $1M tokens.
- Month 12 (4.5B tokens): with reserved + autoscaling + cache: ~$12–$20 per $1M tokens.

Mapping to your margin target:
- To hit >=60% feature gross margin, target total cost (infra+model+support) must be <= 40% of price. If you want to charge $X per 1M tokens as pass-through, we recommend target price of $30–$50 per $1M in early phases to preserve margin after support and infra.

Tradeoffs and levers we recommend:
- Reserved capacity (Dedicated) for predictable unit cost at scale — reduces $/1M by ~30–40% at 900M+ tokens/month vs hosted.
- Quantized model variants and aggressive batching can lower inference cost but require validation for QA/regression risk.
- Pre-warming and regional routing to match latency SLO for interactive use.

I've attached the working unit_econ_model.xlsx with line items for CAC payback (assumptions: $120 CAC, ARPU per paying user, conversion %), feature-level P&L, and sensitivity to $/1M tokens. Please review and we can finalize numbers on the call.

Confirming Wed 3/4 10:00 PT for a 30-min working session with Rishi — invite coming from my calendar.

Best,
Marissa
